title: Virtual File System Row Selection
description: All VirtualFileSystem file nodes must show hover and support full multi-select: shift for range, ctrl/cmd for toggle, plain click for single select.
summary: VirtualFileSystem rows are always hoverable and selectable with built-in shift-range and ctrl/cmd-toggle multi-select (shared with Tree selection math). Platform uses setVirtualFileSystemRowSelection; sketchpad home maps kit row ids. Tests added in @semio-tech/ui-react and @semio-tech/framework-platform-core.
